------------------------------- -- // Meta -------------------------------
---@class Particle ---@field X number ---@field Y number
------------------------------- -- // Constants -------------------------------
--[[ The height particle start at. ]] PARTICLE_START_Y = -4
--[[ The speed of particles. ]] PARTICLE_SPEED = 0.5
--[[ The size of particles. ]] PARTICLE_RADIUS = 1
--[[ The particle spawn interval in ticks. ]] PARTICLE_SPAWN_INTERVAL = 2
------------------------------- -- // Variables -------------------------------
--[[ The amount of ticks passed. ]] local tick = 0
--[[ The screen dimensions. ]] ---@type number, number local screen_width, screen_height
--[[r A unique ID that increments ]] local _ID = 0
--[[ A table containing particles. ]] ---@type table<integer, Particle> local particles = {}
------------------------------- -- // Functions -------------------------------
--[[ Gets a unique ID. ]] ---@return integer function getID() _ID = _ID + 1 return _ID end
--[[ Spawns a particles. ]] function spawnParticle() if not screen_width then return end
local particle = { X = math.random(0, screen_width), Y = PARTICLE_START_Y }
particles[getID()] = particle end
--[[ Handles all particles. ]] function handleParticles() for index, particle in pairs(particles) do particle.Y = particle.Y + PARTICLE_SPEED
if particle.Y > screen_height then particles[index] = nil end end
if tick % PARTICLE_SPAWN_INTERVAL == 0 then spawnParticle() end end
------------------------------- -- // Main -------------------------------
function onTick() tick = tick + 1 handleParticles() end
function onDraw() screen_width, screen_height = screen.getWidth(), screen.getHeight()
-- Background screen.setColor(215, 215, 215) screen.drawClear()
-- Particles for _, particle in pairs(particles) do screen.setColor(46, 47, 48) screen.drawCircleF(particle.X, particle.Y, PARTICLE_RADIUS) end
-- Text local textStartY = screen_height / 2 - 10 screen.setColor(0, 0, 0, 220) screen.drawRectF(0, textStartY, screen_width, 8)
screen.setColor(225, 225, 225) screen.drawText(7, textStartY + 2.5, "cuhhub.com - Event starting soon, please wait!") end
